name: Image Of God
overview: Scripture reveals that humanity was created uniquely in the image and likeness of God, as declared in Genesis 1:26-27, granting mankind a special role over creation. This divine image imparts inherent value to human life, affirmed by Genesis 9:6, which underscores the sanctity of life made in God's image. Furthermore, the New Testament points to Jesus Christ as the perfect image of the invisible God (Colossians 1:15), and believers are called to be conformed to His image (Romans 8:29), embodying righteousness and holiness as described in Ephesians 4:24.
